content:
ZOTAC ZBOX PRO CM5-PICO is a compact fanless industrial mini PC built around the Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5 (CM5) with up to 16 GB LPDDR4x memory, optional WiFi 5 and Bluetooth 5.0 wireless connectivity. The mini PC measures 114.8 x 76 x 31.3 mm and features two 4K HDMI outputs, Gigabit Ethernet, and M.2 expansion for NVMe storage or AI accelerators, along with an internal 40-pin GPIO header, camera interfaces, and a wide 5V to 20V DC input for industrial automation, digital signage, and IoT gateway applications. All I/O ports are placed on a single side to simplify cable management and stacking. ZOTAC ZBOX PRO CM5-PICO specifications: SoM – Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5 (CM5) SoC – Broadcom BCM2712 CPU – Quad-core Arm Cortex-A76 @ 2.4 GHz GPU – VideoCore VII @ 800 MHz with H.265 hardware video decoding Memory – 2GB, 4GB, 8GB, or 16GB LPDDR4x RAM Storage [...]
